text.body: gaurīśaṃkarabhikṣuviracitaḥ sarvatantrasiddhāntapadārthalakṣaṇasaṃgrahaḥ śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ, namaḥ paramarṣibhyaḥ tvāṃ vinā niḥsvarupo'haṃ māṃ vinā tvaṃ kathaṃ sthitaḥ | diṣṭyedānīṃ mayā labdho yo'si so'si namostu te || śrīcetanakiṅkarāhvaśrīmadrāmapuryāhvayoḥ | vande pādau tathā śrīmaddhīrālālāhvadhīmatām || śraddādhanena saṃgṛhītaṃ gaurīśaṃkarabhikṣuṇā | bodhāya vādibādhāya viduṣāṃ kaṇṭhabhūṣaṇam || kva ! granthakaraṇaṃ kva tvamiti mā jānatāstikāḥ | satsaṃgānugrahaḥ kiṃ ? kiṃ na karotyevamāha vāk || prajñā śabdamayasyāsya dehasya mama durjanāḥ | dayaddhvaṃ praharaddhvaṃ tu cediṣṭaṃ pāñcabhautike || pramāṇasiddhāntaviruddhamatra yatkincanābhūnmatimāndyadoṣāt | mātsaryamutsārya mahānubhāvāḥ prasādamādhāya viśodhayantu || vidvāṃso yadi mama doṣamudgireyuḥ yadvā te guṇagaṇameva kīrtayeyuḥ | tulyaṃ tadbahu manute mano madīyaṃ kaṣṭaṃ tadvad manute yadāha mandaḥ || doṣatvamujvalaguṇā api yānti yeṣu tairunnateḥ kimathaveha tiraskṛteḥ kim | doṣo'pi yeṣu guṇatāmupayānti bhūyān tebhyo namostu satataṃ bhuvi sajjanebhyaḥ || nanu kimarthaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃgrahāraṃbho lakṣaṇānāmanupayogāditi ceducyate -- asti hi mahānupayogastathā hi yathā vivāhe salakṣaṇo varo lakṣaṇavatīṃ kanyāmupayaccheteti -- aviplutabrahmacaryo lakṣaṇyāṃ striyamudvahet etaireva guṇairyuktaḥ savarṇaḥ śrotriyo varaḥ ityādivacanaiḥ stripuruṣasāmudrikalakṣaṇānāṃ vivāha upayogāt | liṅgaṃ salakṣaṇaṃ pūjyaṃ tyajelliṅgamalakṣaṇam | tasmātsarvaprayatnena liṅgaṃ kuryāt salakṣaṇam || ityādivacanairliṅgalakṣaṇānāṃ tatpūjādāvupayogāt, evāmanyeṣāmapi lakṣaṇānāṃ yathāsaṃbhavamupayogādyukta eva lakṣaṇasaṃgrahārambha iti | lakṣaṇānāmupayogaḥ pūrvācāryairapi darśitaḥ -- ṛṣayopi padārthānāṃ nāntaṃ yānti pṛthaktvaśaḥ| lakṣaṇena tu siddhānāmantaṃ yānti vipaścitaḥ || kiñca -- lakṣaṇapramāṇābhyāṃ vastusiddhirna tu pratijñāmātreṇeti nyāyādapi padārtha lakṣaṇamavaśyamapekṣaṇīyam | tatra pramāṇaṃ vihāya lakṣaṇāni nirūpayāma iti | akasmātvam kāraṇādhīnatvamaniścitakāraṇatvaṃ vā | || akrūratvam || vṛthāpūrvapakṣādikāriṣvapi śiṣyādiṣvapriyabhāṣaṇādivyatirekeṇa bodhayitṛtvam | || akṣaratvam || varṇasmārakatve sati lipisanniveśatvam | || akhaṇḍārthatvam || sajātīyavijātīyasvagatabhedaśūnyatvam | sāṅkhyātmanyativyāptivāraṇāya sajātīyeti, ākāśetivyāptivāraṇāya vijātīyeti | aparyāyānekaśabdaprakāśyatve satyaviśiṣṭatvam | nīlo ghaṭa ityādyaparyāyānekaśabdprakāśye tādātmyena nīlaviśiṣṭe ghaṭādyarthetiprasaṅgavāraṇārthamaviśiṣṭatvadalam, tathā " ghaṭaḥ kalaśaḥ kumbhaḥ '' ityādiparyāyānekaśabdaprakāśye aviśiṣṭe ghaṭādāvatiprasaṅgavyudāsāya satyantam | || akhaṇḍārthavākyatvam || saṃsargānavagāhiyathārthajñānajanakatvam | rājapuruṣa ityādau saṃsargapare vākyetivyāptivāraṇāya saṃsargānavagāhīti | tatprātipadikārthamātraparyavasāyitvam | || akhaṃḍopādhiḥ|| anirvacanīyo dharmaḥ | asamavetatve satyanugatatvam | || akhyātiḥ || svarūpato viṣayataścāgṛhītabhedenaikajñānam | ekaviṣayānekajñāneṣvativyāptiparihārārthaṃ svarūpapadam, samūhālaṃbanajñānetivvyāptiparihārārthaṃ viṣaya iti viśeṣaṇam, khyātereva - bhramajñānasyaiva abhāva iti | || agnihotram || āhiteṣvagniṣu sāyaṃ prātaścānuṣṭheyo homaḥ | || aghaṭakatvam || tadviṣayatvāvyāpakaviṣayatāvatvam | || aṅgatvam || upakārakatvam | tadīyapradhānaphalajanakavyāpārajanakatve sati tadīyapradhānaphalājanakatvam | ghaṭādāvativyāptivāraṇāya satyantam | vedārthajñānopayogitvam | || ajahallakṣaṇā || śakyārthāparityāgena tatsaṃbandhyarthāntare vṛttiḥ, yathā śoṇo dhāvatītyatra śoṇapadasya śoṇaguṇaviśiṣṭe aśvādidravye | jahallakṣaṇāyāmativyāptivāraṇāya śakyarthāparityāgeneti | lakṣyatāvacchedakarūpeṇa lakṣyaśakyobhayabodhaprayojikā lakṣaṇā | || ajñatvam || gurumukhānadhītaśāstratvam, ātmajñānaśūnyatvaṃ vā | ātmānaṃ jānātīti jñaḥ na jñaḥ ajñaḥ | || ajñānam || kāryamātropādānatve sati sadasadbhyāmanirvacanīyam | anādibhāvarūpatve sati vijñānanirāsyam | uttarajñānanivartyapūrvajñānavāraṇāyānādirūpeti, prāgabhāvavāraṇāya, jñānābhāvo ajñānamityāśaṅkānirāsārthaṃ vā bhāvarūpeti, ātmanyativyāptivāraṇāya jñānanirāsyamiti | mithyātve sati sākṣājjñānanivartyatvam | jñānenecchāprāgabhāvaḥ sākṣānnivartyata iti vadantaṃ prati satyantam, ajñānanivṛttidvārā jñānanivartyabandhe ativyāptivāraṇāya sākṣāditi | anādyupādānatve sati mithyātvam | brahmanirāsārthaṃ mithyātvamiti, mṛdādinirāsārthamanādīti, aviddyātmanoḥ saṃbandhanirāsārthamupādānatve satīti | || ajñānanigrahasthānam || pariṣadā vijñātasya vādinā trirabhihitasyāpi vākyārthasyābodhaḥ | || aṇutvam || sūkṣmapadārthatve satyāraṃbhakatvam | || atikramaṇam || ucitādadhikasyānuṣṭhānam | || atithiḥ || ajñātapūrvagṛhāgatavyaktiḥ | || atideśaḥ || svaviṣayamullṅghyānyaviṣaye upadeśaḥ | ekatra śrutasyānyatra saṃbandhaḥ | || atiprasaṅgaḥ || yasya bodho yatrābhimatastadanyasyāpi bodhaprasaṅgaḥ | prastutaviṣayādanyatra prasaktirvā | || ativādaḥ || nirarthakotipralāpaḥ | || ativyāptitvam || lakṣyavṛttitve satyalakṣyavṛttitvam, yathā goḥ śriṅgitvaṃ lakṣyaṇam | lakṣyagovṛttitve satyalakṣyamahiṣyādivṛtti | || atiśayatāpaḥ || svādhikataradevatotkarṣadarśane jāyamānastāpaḥ | || atiśayoktiḥ || paurvāparyaviparyayaḥ | || atīndriyatvam || laukikasākṣātkāraviṣayaguṇatvanyūnavṛttisanskāratvānyadharmasamavāyyanyaguṇatvam | || atyantanivṛttiḥ || kāraṇasahitakāryanivṛttiḥ,svapratiyogijātīyaprāgabhāvāsamānādhikaraṇavṛttirvā || atyantābhāvaḥ || traikālikasaṃsargāvacchinnapratiyogitāko'bhāvaḥ, yathā bhūtale ghaṭo nāsti, dhvansaprāgabhāvavāraṇāya traikāliketi, bhedavāraṇāya saṃsargetyādi | || adṛṣṭatvam || vidhiniṣedhajanyatve satyatīndriyatvam | || adbhūtaḥ || siddhasya dharmiṇo dharmyantarāvayavairyogaḥ | vismayajanako vyāpāraḥ | cakitādyanubhāvitatve sati harṣādisaṃcāritatvaṃ vā | || advaitatvam || sajātīyavijātīyasvagatabhedaśūnyatvam | || adhamatvam || bhayadayālajjāśūnyatvam, kāmakrīḍāviṣaye kartavyākartavyāvicārakatvamiti rasamañjaryām | || adharmaḥ || vedādiniṣiddhakarmajanyanarakajanakatvam, vedādiniṣiddhakarmajanyaṃ pāpam | vedabodhitāniṣṭasādhanatākatvam, viṣabhakṣaṇādivaraṇāya vedeti | brahmayāgādivāraṇāyāniṣṭeti | || adhikam || adhikahetvādikathanam, yogyaparimāṇātikramatvam | || adhikaraṇam || sākṣātparaṃparayā vā kriyāśrayaḥ, kartṛkarmadvārakaphalavyāpārādhāraḥ, yathā sthālyāmodanaṃ gṛhe pacatīti | vedavicārātmako nyāyaḥ | viṣayo viśayaścaiva pūrvapakṣastathottaram | nirṇayaśceti pañcāṅgaṃ śāstredhikaraṇaṃ viduḥ || || adhikāraḥ || uttarottarasaṃbandhaḥ, phalabhoktritve sati karmakartṛtvam, yatheṣṭaṃ krayavikrayādikartṛtvasaṃpādakassvāmitvamiti dharmaśāstrajñā iti | svadeśe lakṣyasanskāropayogivākyārthabodhājanakatve sati paradeśe vākyārthabodhajanakatvamiti vaiyākaraṇāḥ | anekadehāraṃbhaka balavatprārabdhakarmaphalatvam | || adhikāravidhiḥ || setikartavyatākasya karaṇasya yāgādeḥ phalasaṃbandho vidhiḥ, yathā yajeta svargakāmaḥ | || adhikārī || mukhyagauṇaprayojanapraptikāmī | tattatkarmajanyaphalārthitvam | tattatkarmakaraṇayogyatāvān | malavikṣeparahitatve sati sādhanacatuṣṭayasaṃpannatve sati svasvarūpajñānavatvam | || adhiṣṭhātṛtvam || saṃnidhānamātreṇa tattatpadārthānāṃ tattatkarmaṣu niyantritvam | || adhiṣṭhānam || yadādhāramāropyaṃ bhāsate tat | sattāsphūrtipradātritvam | savilāsājñānaviṣayatvaṃ vā | svabuddhibāddhyakāryādhāratvamityapi | || addhyayanam || akṣaramātrapāṭha iti vaidikāḥ | sārthākṣaragrahaṇamiti mīmānsakāḥ| pūrvagurumukhoccāraṇatve sattyuttaraśiṣyoccāraṇatvam | || adhyastatvam || saṃprayogasanskārajanyatve sati pratyabhijñābhinnatvam | || addhyātmatvam || ātmānāṃ dehendriyādikaṃ kṣetrajña brahma vā adhikṛtya vartamānatvam | || addhyātmaśāstratvam || ātmānamadhikṛtya pravṛttaṃ śāstram | || addhyāropaḥ || vastunyavastvāropaḥ, yathā śuktikāśakalādau rajatādeḥ | || addhyāsaḥ || paratra parāvabhāsaḥ | adhiṣṭhānaviṣamasattākāvabhāsa iti parimale | ekāvacchedena svasansṛjyamāne svātyantābhāvavatyavabhāsaḥ | svātyantābhāvavatyavabhāsa etāvanmātroktau yatra bhūtalādau ghaṭopasaritaḥ punaścānītastādṛśaghaṭādāvatiprasaṅgaḥ syāditi svasaṃsṛjyamāna ittyuktam | evamapi mūlāvacchedena kapisaṃyogātyantābhāvavati vṛkṣe śākhāgrāvacchedena ca tatsaṃsṛjyamāne avabhāsamānatvātsaṃyogasya tatratiprasaṅgaḥ syādityata ekāvacchedenetyuktam | adhiṣṭhānasāmānyajñānajanyatve sati doṣajanyatvam | pāramārthikatvāvacchinnasvātyantābhāvādhikaraṇe pratīyamānatvamiti tatvaviveke| sa dvividho jñānāddhyāsaḥ, arthāddhyāsaśca | yadvā svarūpāddhyāsaḥ, saṃsargāddhyāsaśca iti dvividha addhyāsaḥ | tatrādyo rajjvādau bhujaṃgādhyāsa ātmani vā anātmādhyāsaḥ | dvitīyastu sphaṭike lauhityasya śaṅkhe ca pītimna anātmani cātmataddharmādeḥ, ātmādeḥ pāramārthikatvena svarūpata addhyāsābhāvāt | athavā prakārāntareṇa sopādhiko nirupādhikaśceti bhedādaddhyāso dvividhaḥ | dvividhopyasau bāhyābhyāntarabhedātpunardvividhaḥ | tatra lohitasphaṭikādirbāhyaḥ sopādhiko bhramaḥ, japākusumāderupādhitvāt | kartṛtvādibhrama āntaraḥ, karmarūpeṇa pariṇatā avidyārūpopādhikāryatvāt | śuktirūpyādistu bāhyo nirupādhiko bhramaḥ| ākaśādibhramopi bāhyo nirupādhikaḥ | ahamajño brahma na jānāmītyādyābhyantaro nirupādhiko bhramaḥ | ityādīni boddhavyāni | vistarastu gurumukhādevāvagantavyam | || addhyāhāraḥ || agatikā gatiḥ | prakṛtopayogiśabdakalpanam | śrutapadānusandhānaṃ vā | || addhvaryutvam || karmāraṃbhasamāptikartṛtvam | || anavasthā || upapādyopapādakapravāhonavadhiḥ | cakrakavvyāvṛtyarthamanavadhiriti, sākāṃkṣyatāparihārāyopapādyopapādaketi |
